authorization: Complete protocol design and validation only, following E28/E29. No formal TRAIN, real outcome reader, optimizer, BLIND or ATPG execution is authorized by this plan.
research_goal: Fixed H64/M16/F4 D95-safe action recommendation: reduce charged ATPG wall time until epsilon-near-optimal hit; cycles define quality, not elapsed cost.
positive_definition: all D95-safe actions with 100*cycles <= 101*minimum safe cycles in the fixed task; no single best-positive selection

model.dtype_limit: both new arms match E29 verification; historical v5 was float32, so not an estimator-only comparison against v5

normalizer.fit_population: five fitting TRAIN families only in each LOFO fold
normalizer.gap: generated identity normalizer and abs(feature)<=2 VJP bridge are not production real-fold support

folds: leave one TRAIN family out; five fitting families and one TRAIN-held family per fold; not BLIND
denominator_policy: report all six families and five informative hit families separately; keep s35932 in six-family macro results even though ten actions make top10 exhaustive
initialization: same seed, model factory, CPU dtype and initial parameter SHA for paired arms; no existing checkpoint read

sampler_schedule.domain: a fresh addressed main and pilot stream per model-seed index, held-family fold, update and fitting-family index; independent of outcomes
sampler_schedule.indices: seed_index in fixed seeds list 0..2; held_index and task_index in fixed train_families list 0..5; epoch_index 0..119; skip task_index==held_index
sampler_schedule.paired_arm_coupling: both arms use the same main RNG seed and common random numbers for their first 480 trajectory draws; chosen action paths need not coincide once scores diverge; raw draws 512 trajectories, treatment draws 480 main plus 32 separately addressed pilot trajectories
sampler_schedule.collision_proof: all main seeds unique and even; XOR constant odd gives unique odd pilot seeds, hence no pilot/main or cross-call overlap
sampler_schedule.claim_limit: PRNG separation implements the independent-stream model; it is not empirical certification of mathematical independence or unbiasedness of an adaptive deterministic training run

arms.risk_method: E26 dS+(S-b)*dlogq; independent pilot b frozen before main

common_training_objective.cost: exact multi-positive complete first-hit fixed-additive C/B
common_training_objective.B: N*max(charged task runtime), fixed with respect to scores
common_training_objective.weights_status: fresh prospective choices fixed for both arms, no tuning on TRAIN-held outcomes
common_training_objective.gradient_application: supply explicit score-gradient VJP; do not autograd the MC scalar as though it contains the proposal-score term
common_training_objective.macro_average: one equal task weight per fitting family including structural-zero risk tasks

isolated_variable: risk estimator only BETWEEN these two new arms; do not claim this isolates one change relative to historical v5 ranking loss
historical_v5_difference: v5 used best-positive/top10-negative macro softplus and float32; both target and dtype differ from this prospective comparison

optimizer_plan.name: Adam
optimizer_plan.budget_rationale: prospectively reuse established real-v5 120 fullbatch updates, not E22 synthetic 24 steps; fixed for both new arms without held tuning

planned_budget.scope: planning ceiling, not executed; total work is twice one-arm matrix; structural-zero risk tasks may skip actual paths, no equal wall-time claim

evaluation.primary_endpoint: first epsilon-hit or hard K10 stop, charge each visited attempt before checking hit so first hit cost is included; miss charges all visited attempts
evaluation.fit_vs_transfer: FIT and TRAIN-held results reported separately per family and seed
required_metrics: charged prefix wall time including failures/timeouts/retries
per-row hit or censored-at-K10 flag and charged prefix, without inferred uncensored time-to-hit
evaluation.failure_policy: all attempts charged; never fastest-success, missing elapsed imputation, or dropping failed candidates; exact attempt lineage join required
evaluation.freeze: freeze all scores, ranking, action UIDs, model and normalizer SHAs with ordinary-file bounded readback before TRAIN-held outcomes may be loaded
baselines: action-UID fixed ordering frozen before outcomes
predeclared deployable fixed rule frozen before outcomes
evaluation.oracle_cost_ordering: may only be labeled nondeployable diagnostic; never a fair deployable baseline
evaluation.censoring_limit: K10 censoring time depends on arm ranking and action costs; no noninformative-censoring assumption, hit-only average speedup, pooled Kaplan-Meier or inferred mean time-to-hit claim
evaluation.aggregation: first average the three fixed seeds within each family; report six-family and five-informative-family paired rows separately; family is the unit, not fifteen independent family-seed observations
evaluation.inference: descriptive paired diagnostic only, no significance or population-generalization claim from five informative families
evaluation.prospective_success_criterion: all fifteen informative TRAIN-held family-seed rows: treatment hit@10 >= raw hit@10 and charged prefix cost <= raw + 1e-9 seconds; at least one informative row hit by BOTH arms has treatment prefix cost < raw - 1e-9 seconds; all six-family rows and FIT outcomes still reported; no average can override a failing row
evaluation.criterion_limit: strict descriptive research criterion, not a statistical significance or minimum practical speedup threshold
evaluation.claim_limits: historical fixed-additive replay is not measured online incremental ATPG wall time or prefix-reuse equivalence

interpretation.fit_failure: if FIT objective/ranking does not improve, diagnose optimization/target implementation before transfer claims
interpretation.transfer_failure: FIT improves but TRAIN-held does not: report cross-family transfer failure, no blind tuning

release_gates.requirement: new real-fold multi-task caller and fit-only normalizer with full UID joins; generated-only E28 adapter cannot be relabeled production
prove real normalized features and unmodified model scores satisfy explicit production domains without silent clipping; E29 bounded synthetic input is insufficient
independent evidence candidate universe and limit-fraction denominators were frozen before outcomes/execution
reverify D95-safe common-fault mapping and action UID lineage for the actual training package, not old status claims alone
unique attempt/action join plus failures/timeouts/retry elapsed charged without filtering; SUCCESS-only E24/v5 replay is not sufficient
production ordinary-file readback, SHA/model/normalizer/candidate joins, zero outcome I/O before freeze; in-memory generated gate is not an OS sandbox
bounded macro-gradient accumulation/serial trainer, synthetic resource and deterministic leak tests, fresh dependency/container gates and independent review
separate full-stage authorization for these new 36 fits after all technical gates pass; this three-step request approved a plan, not training execution
